lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gills. The spots are vertically aligned in approximately 5 to 6 visible columns across the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: The high-luminance blobs are positioned at the intersections of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal rows, forming a structured lattice of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light pixels on the dorsal side to dark shadow pixels on the ventral side of each ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 7 to 9 visible high-luminance spots of varying sizes, primarily distributed in the lower and middle regions of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple smaller dark silhouettes (likely remoras) attached to or swimming in close proximity to the ventral-lateral region of the shark.
